name: Root out Heresy
summary: Adeptus Arbites, Inquisitor, Inquisitorial Agents and Ordo Hereticus models get Ignores Cover on ranged weapons, and Sustained Hits 1 when attacking a Chaos unit of 5 or more models.

name: Destroy the Daemonic
summary: Inquisitor, Inquisitorial Agents and Ordo Malleus models re-roll a Hit roll of 1 on every attack, and a Wound roll of 1 when the target is a Daemon unit.

name: Extremis Sanction
summary: Officio Assassinorum units can use their signature ability (Overkill, Soulless Horror, or Shieldbreaker) twice per battle instead of once, never twice in one round. Each gains its Extremis ability for a mandatory points increase.
